messages:
ana: morning async — onboarding tinyq-v2 canary. Ran overnight eval sweep against safety+coverage promptsets and saw ~7% hallucination uptick on safety_set_A. unsure if this is quantization or runtime cache behavior.

ana: what I did: uploaded model artifact tinyq-v2, kicked off canary (5% traffic), ran nightly evals, grabbed failing shards and a small repro.

ana: blocker: can't reproduce locally with current dev image — local kv warmup seems okay, but canary instances show KV_CACHE_MISMATCH warnings in logs.

mike: which eval and sample? can you paste a failing example or link the dashboard?

ana: dashboard: https://redwood.internal/evals/6789 (private) — exported a few failing prompts below.

ana: failing sample: 
```
User: summarize the contract changes
Model: (confident hallucinated clause about payment terms)
```

ana: log snippet from canary instance: 
```
WARN runtime.kv: kv_cache_mismatch seq=1024 expected=0 at step=12 (model=tinyq-v2, quant=8bit)
ERROR infra.request: increased decode errors 0.9% -> 7.8% over 30m
```

sophia: hmm, seen similar when prefix caching didn't survive a quantized kernel switch. microQ had a patch for warmup ordering.

sophia: can you check the model config (kv_ordering, warmup_steps)? maybe the checkpoint uses a different ordering.

raj: tagging runtime/oncall: @li — did yesterday's kernel perf push touch any memory alignment or kv eviction paths?

li: I pushed attention/perf kernel 1.3.7 yesterday (opt for 2048 blocks). I didn't intentionally change KV code, but the alignment tweak touches buffer allocation which could affect pointer math for some quantized loaders. I'll grep logs and run a quick build.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout for tinyq-v2 (deployment id d-3321) automatically PAUSED due to error rate spike in us-west. See https://redwood.internal/deploys/d-3321

mike: OK hold canary globally until we triage. @sophia can you take a quick look at PR #4521 (kv warmup ordering fix) — https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4521 ? low risk.

sophia: will review now, aim EOD. :eyes:

li: building a debug image with extra KV sanity checks, will push tag: redwood/runtime:kv-fix-2026-03-17-debug — ETA 45m. includes extra logging: `kv_debug=true` and alignment guards.

ana: perfect. blocker removed if we get an image to repro. I'll run smoke with the debug image against the failing shard and share traces.

raj: I'll add a quick eval gate test that runs the failing shard as part of canary pre-flight. If it fails we keep canary paused.

mike: assigning follow-ups — li to build image, sophia to review PR, raj to add gate, ana to run smoke and post results. I'll keep canary paused and update infra. :thumbsup:

ana: thanks team — will post results in this thread. If anyone needs me I'll be on for the next 3 hours to run repros.

li: pushed image redwood/runtime:kv-fix-2026-03-17-debug (digest sha256:abc123...), sharing artifact link: https://artifacts.redwood/runtime/kv-fix-2026-03-17-debug

ana: pulling now, running smoke.

sophia: quick note for reviewers — PR #4521 modifies warmup order and adds a small synchronization barrier; low perf hit but fixes observed decode race.

mike: thanks, update here when smoke done.

ana: smoke done: debug logs show kv_debug warnings at init, but no mismatches during decoding. running full eval now, will post numbers (small sample) in ~25m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
